name: MEM
summary: A rare psychedelic amphetamine discovered by Alexander Shulgin. Related to the DOx class of drugs, there is little known about the obscure compounds pharmacology. However, it is suspected to have a high potency and to have a long duration.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: MEM is a serotonergic psychedelic and acts as a selective serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist. It is specifically a full agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A and 5-HT2C receptors and to a lesser extent is a partial to full agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2B receptor. The psychedelic effects of MEM are thought to be mediated by serotonin 5-HT2A receptor activation.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.en: It has had very little recreational use and has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它的娛樂性使用非常少，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它的娱乐性使用非常少，没有医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Related psychedelic amphetamines of the DOx family can cause anxiety, nausea, raised heart rate and blood pressure and very long experiences, and some have been linked to seizures and deaths.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。相關的 DOx 類迷幻安非他命可能引起焦慮、噁心、心跳與血壓上升，以及非常漫長的體驗，其中一些曾與癲癇發作和死亡有關。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。相关的 DOx 类迷幻安非他命可能引起焦虑、恶心、心跳与血压上升，以及非常漫长的体验，其中一些曾与癫痫发作和死亡有关。

fact.en: MEM is 2,5-dimethoxy-4-ethoxyamphetamine, one of the TMA-2 variants that Shulgin made by swapping methoxy groups for ethoxy groups and described in PiHKAL.
fact.zh: MEM 即2,5-二甲氧基-4-乙氧基安非他命，是舒爾金把 TMA-2 的甲氧基換成乙氧基所製成的變體之一，記載於《PiHKAL》。
fact.zhHans: MEM 即2,5-二甲氧基-4-乙氧基安非他命，是舒尔金把 TMA-2 的甲氧基换成乙氧基所制成的变体之一，记载于《PiHKAL》。
